notes: Graded blind from the supplied source, records and mechanical audits; no additional browser session was run. For c2, a queue list inside a glass host is content on glass even when each row is clickable. For c4, a family spanning the size-law region and extending beyond 96 counts; exact 32px and 96px endpoint controls are not required. For c7, both cells receive partial credit for a real control-to-action-menu morph, not full credit: neither implements the specifically requested queue transition. For c10, the required recorded measurement must belong to the authored cell; the independently supplied audit is corroboration, not a substitute for that authoring step. A hardcodes light and B hardcodes dark, so neither audit emulation actually exercises both material schemes. No demonstrably false runtime claim was found. A explicitly acknowledges its queue-content and fixed-scheme exceptions; those explanations do not waive the criteria. No inference was made about authorship, and no restricted files were read.
